scenes.headline: How a diffusion model learns to plan
scenes.sub: Generative Trajectory Planning, from the paper and the code
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sheave! This agent has no policy. It has a model that proposes whole plans, and it learns from the plans its own search finds.

scenes.text: Sample whole action sequences from a diffusion prior, refine them by search through learned models, then train the prior on the winners.
scenes.mark: train the prior on the winners
scenes.say: Sample whole action sequences from a diffusion model, improve them by search, then teach the model the winners.

steps.say: The state goes into a diffusion model over whole action sequences. It samples thirty-two plans.
A beam search copies the best few and re-noises only their uncommitted actions, then denoises them.
Five learned dynamics models roll each plan forward, and a reward model and value function score it.
Repeat once per step of the horizon, then execute the first action and plan again.

items.say: Plan from replayed states, scoring cautiously with the median model.
The value function learns the planned returns.
Noisy gradient steps push the winners uphill, against collapse.
The diffusion model learns the elites, weighted by score.

scenes.title: The update, idealized
scenes.text: p_new(a) = p(a) x exp(J(a) / lambda) / Z
scenes.say: In the limit, each round does one thing.

parts.note: plans that score well gain mass
parts.say: Weight every plan by its exponentiated score. Good plans gain mass, and the expected score provably improves.

left.title: Gaussian proposal
items: Averages two good routes into one
left.say: A Gaussian has one mode, so two good routes around an obstacle average into a bad one.

right.title: Diffusion prior
right.say: A diffusion prior keeps both routes.

scenes.title: PushT from pixels, success after 1M steps
scenes.say: Pushing a block from pixels, the reinforcement learning baselines stay at zero. The Gaussian planner reaches thirty-three percent. This one, ninety-nine.

scenes.label: per action with planning switched off, still 99% success
scenes.say: And once trained, one sample from the prior is enough. Planning off, pick and place still succeeds ninety-nine percent of the time.

scenes.text: Search is the teacher. Once the prior has learned from it, the prior can act alone.
scenes.say: Search is the teacher. Then the prior can act alone.

recap: A diffusion prior proposes whole plans
Beam search refines and scores them
scenes.say: The prior proposes, search improves, and the winners train the prior.
